description: This is a PHP class defining the 'OAuthClient' entity for an ORM (Object-Relational Mapping) framework, specifically Doctrine ORM. It models an OAuth 2.0 client with properties such as id, name, client ID, client secret, redirect URI, confidentiality, and enabled status, along with corresponding getters and setters.

classes.name: OAuthClient
classes.description: Entity class representing an OAuth 2.0 client, mapped to the 'ohrm_oauth2_client' database table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the OAuth client.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the OAuth client.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the OAuth client.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the OAuth client.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID used in OAuth authentication.

methods.name: setClientId
methods.description: Sets the client ID for OAuth authentication.

methods.name: getClientSecret
methods.description: Returns the client secret, if any, associated with the OAuth client.

methods.name: setClientSecret
methods.description: Sets the client secret for OAuth client.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI registered for the OAuth client.

methods.name: setRedirectUri
methods.description: Sets the redirect URI for the OAuth client.

methods.name: isConfidential
methods.description: Indicates whether the client is confidential.

methods.name: setConfidential
methods.description: Sets whether the client is confidential.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the OAuth client is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the OAuth client.
